findings: Japanese display name → empty ID: toId() strips all non-ASCII characters, so a Japanese-only display name (e.g. 'かっこいいモブ') produces id='' and blocks Step2 submission. Fix: skip the id overwrite when toId() returns empty string.

WizardProgress totalSteps/steps mismatch: totalSteps prop only feeds the counter label; step dots come from a hardcoded 3-element array. The prop API implies generic step count control it does not deliver. Remove the prop or make the steps array driven by props.

entity.status.scale misused as file tree label in EditorPage sidebar: semantically wrong (a numeric property label used as a directory name), and in ja-kids mode the key falls back to English because ja-kids.json has no entity.status block.
Duplicate import in WizardPage.tsx: WizardStep2 and isValidId are imported in two separate import statements from the same module '@/components/wizard/WizardStep2'. Merge into one.
Hardcoded Japanese strings in EditorPage (PLACEHOLDER_ENTITY_NAME, 'スポーン設定', 'ドロップテーブル') bypass i18n. Tracked as Phase 3 TODO in progress.md; recommend resolving before Phase 3 begins.
